An oral request for quotations will be solicited for the following items as a small purchase:

Item Description:        Temper Frame Ridge

NSN:                           8340-01-186-3008-Ridge

Qty:                             300

Item Description:        Eave Extender

NSN:                           8340-01-186-3009

Qty:                             500

Item Description:        Purlin

NSN:                           8340-01-186-3005

Qty:                             305

Delivery destination is VSTJ, Pendergrass, GA with one delivery 150 days after award. Submittal of First Article is required 75 days after date of award at the contractor’s facility. This RFQ will be issued as Unrestricted with an Evaluation Preference for Small Businesses in a Hub Zone. RFQ document can be obtained by contacting Nick DiNofa by e-mail at Nicholas.DiNofa@dla.mil. This document will be available until April 24, 2026. Oral quotations will be requested at the same time as this announcement. The closing date for oral quotations is 3:00 PM ET, April 24, 2026.

The Defense Appropriations and Authorization Acts and other statutes (including what is commonly referred to as “The Berry Amendment”) impose restrictions on the DOD’s acquisition of foreign products and services. Generally, Clothing and Textile items (as defined in 252.225-7014), including the materials and components thereof (other than sensors, electronics, or other items added to, and not normally associated with clothing), must be grown, reprocessed, reused, melted or produced in the United States, its possessions or Puerto Rico, unless one of the DFARS 225.7002-2 exceptions applies.
